description_target.target_text: Each creature (4-center body + 1-tail): rotate body 180, shift opposite to tail until front edge hits wall

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
 ;; Creatures: a yellow(4) heart with four colored petals and a blue(1)
 ;; tail rooted two cells out. Each creature flies flush to the wall
 ;; OPPOSITE its tail direction and turns around — petals swap across
 ;; the heart (up<->down, left<->right) — with the tail riding along.
 ;; Vacated cells refill with the cyan(8) background.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define bg 8)
     (define (creature center)
       (let* ((cr (first center)) (cc (second center))
              (dir (cond ((and (in-bounds? (- cr 2) cc h w)
                               (= (at g (- cr 2) cc) 1)) 'up)
                         ((and (in-bounds? (+ cr 2) cc h w)
                               (= (at g (+ cr 2) cc) 1)) 'down)
                         ((and (in-bounds? cr (- cc 2) h w)
                               (= (at g cr (- cc 2)) 1)) 'left)
                         ((and (in-bounds? cr (+ cc 2) h w)
                               (= (at g cr (+ cc 2)) 1)) 'right)
                         (else 'none)))
              (seed (cond ((eq? dir 'up) (list (- cr 2) cc))
                          ((eq? dir 'down) (list (+ cr 2) cc))
                          ((eq? dir 'left) (list cr (- cc 2)))
                          ((eq? dir 'right) (list cr (+ cc 2)))
                          (else (list cr cc))))
              (tail (connected-region g (first seed) (second seed)
                                      (lambda (r c v) (= v 1)) 8))
              (body (list (list cr cc) (list (- cr 1) cc)
                          (list (+ cr 1) cc) (list cr (- cc 1))
                          (list cr (+ cc 1))))
              (bb (bbox-of-cells (append body tail)))
              (dr (cond ((eq? dir 'down) (- 0 (first bb)))
                        ((eq? dir 'up) (- (- h 1) (third bb)))
                        (else 0)))
              (dc (cond ((eq? dir 'right) (- 0 (second bb)))
                        ((eq? dir 'left) (- (- w 1) (fourth bb)))
                        (else 0))))
         (list (append body tail)
               ;; petals mirror across the heart: the creature turns
               (list (list (+ cr dr) (+ cc dc) 4)
                     (list (+ cr dr -1) (+ cc dc) (cell-down g cr cc))
                     (list (+ cr dr 1) (+ cc dc) (cell-up g cr cc))
                     (list (+ cr dr) (+ cc dc -1) (cell-right g cr cc))
                     (list (+ cr dr) (+ cc dc 1) (cell-left g cr cc)))
               (map (lambda (p) (list (+ (first p) dr)
                                      (+ (second p) dc)))
                    tail))))
     (define creatures
       (map creature
            (filter (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 4))
                    (grid-positions g))))
     (for/fold ((out (erase-cells g (flatmap first creatures) bg)))
               ((c (in-list creatures)))
       (paint-cells (paint-cells out (third c) 1) (second c))))))
